name: Dairy farm LIMS and management platform

mentions.name: Dairy farm LIMS and management platform
mentions.description: This is a LIMS and management platform for dairy farms that consolidates data from the industry's disparate proprietary software systems into a unified Postgres schema, enabling integrated views (e.g., cow health and nutrition together) for proper descriptive and predictive modeling.
mentions.problem: The dairy industry is locked into a couple of proprietary softwares and data surfaces that don't integrate (e.g., cow health and nutrition at the same time).
